mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, order_status, total_amount, payment_status, user_address, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{userAddress}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, price_per_unit, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{pricePerUnit}, #{subtotal})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = #{orderStatus},payment_status=#{paymentStatus}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
